line: List the people you're thankful for, then tell one of them.
paragraph: Sampson James carried his meager possessions in a red backpack during his stint of homelessness. A chance encounter with another Indiana graduate changed everything. The man who once starred on the college ball court found fraternity, philosophical and literal. Steve Hartman found the story on the road. Salvation traveled light that day.

seed.summary: See that red backpack there? Sampson James used it to carry around his meager possessions during a stint of homelessness. Little did James know at the time this photo was taken, however, that it was also carrying around his salvation. seed.sourceTitle: Chance Encounter Between 2 Indiana Graduates Rescues Former College Ball Star from Homelessness
